[RDSC.9.1] The runtime reads atoms in stream order. For each atom
the loader reads the outer frame, then the inner `Atom`'s `oneof`
tag, looks up the registered handler **for that field number**, and
dispatches the body bytes to it ([RFCS.19.1], [RFCS.16.1]).

Reading in stream order is not a licence to act on every atom as it is read:
[RDSC.4c.3] forbids acting on a `CompiledCode` atom at all in this edition.
